events.title: LP Harvest Club
events.summary: A month-long Leelanau wine-club-style passport: participating wineries offer a complimentary flight, tasting, or glass depending on the winery, plus 15% off bottle purchases.
events.planningTruth: Runs throughout September but excludes Saturdays. Choose a starting winery when purchasing, then keep the rest of the day geographically tight rather than trying to collect the whole trail.

events.title: Hunt for the Reds of October
events.summary: An all-October red-wine event built around hand-selected pours and a cork-cash credit, with Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Pinot Noir, Merlot, and other red styles in focus.
events.planningTruth: The month-long format is the advantage. Build a three-winery red-wine route for the part of Leelanau you actually want to explore instead of treating the ticket like a checklist.

events.title: Toast The Season – First Weekend
events.summary: The first 2026 Toast The Season weekend pairs selected wines with food at participating Leelanau Wine Trail wineries and includes cork-cash benefits.
events.planningTruth: Treat the pairing as part of the meal rhythm. Three geographically coherent wineries is a better day than crossing the peninsula repeatedly to maximize stops.

events.title: Toast The Season – Second Weekend
events.summary: The second 2026 Toast The Season weekend repeats the Leelanau trail's wine-and-food pairing format for a second Friday-through-Sunday window.
events.planningTruth: Use the same wine-first pacing rule: three wineries, enough time for the pairing at each, and only one optional non-wine stop.

events.title: Wine & Chocolate Tasting Workshop – Old Mission
events.summary: An evening wine-and-chocolate workshop at the Old Mission tasting room, pairing estate wines with chocolate in an educational tasting format.
events.planningTruth: This is an evening anchor, not another midday tasting. Build the daytime winery route to finish early enough that the workshop still feels like a distinct experience.

events.title: Wine & Chocolate Tasting Workshop – Suttons Bay
events.summary: An evening wine-and-chocolate workshop at the Suttons Bay estate with a guided pairing format.
events.planningTruth: Use it as the final wine event of the day. A northern or Suttons Bay cluster pairs better than a long western-Leelanau loop before a 6:30 PM workshop.

events.title: Estate & Wine Tour – Suttons Bay
events.summary: A one-hour guided estate walk covering the vineyard, inn, barn and wine cave, followed by a hosted wine and spirits tasting.
events.planningTruth: This is useful for a visitor who wants to understand production and place, not just taste. Treat the 11 AM tour as the day's first anchor and choose two later wineries nearby.

events.title: Wine Down Wednesday
events.summary: A West Bay evening cruise with a local-winemaker component and optional local wine tasting package.
events.planningTruth: A useful non-driving finish to a wine day. End daytime tasting early, return to town, and let the evening be about the bay and the winemaker rather than another peninsula stop.

watches.title: Old Mission Mac & Cheese Bake-off
watches.note: The Old Mission Peninsula Wine Trail says to check back in September 2026 for event details. No date or ticket claim is published here until the official trail posts it.
